text_block_list.text:
Ever since setting our sights on running 
in the Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Rice Shower! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
I voted for you in the fan poll! You've 
gotta take 1st place, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hawa!? Th... Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Phew... It's about time to take a break, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Woman
text_block_list.text: Oh, could you perhaps be... Rice Shower?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "Y-Yes! That's true, but..."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Woman
text_block_list.text:
My! Please, have some croquettes from our 
shop! My child is a big fan of yours~.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whaaaat!? Is that really okay!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... With so many wonderful things 
happening... is it really okay for me to 
be this happy?
choice_data_list:
I've been working that much harder, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I wonder if that's true...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Aah, there you both are! I've been looking 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Actually! We just received a call from 
Hanshin Racecourse...!!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Rice-san is running away with 1st place 
in the 'Fan-Voted Popularity Poll'! We 
would be thrilled if she would take part 
in the opening ceremony!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ……Eeeeeeeh!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, since the rehearsal will take 
place tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Hawawa. Rice is... Number 1 favorite? 
The opening ceremony?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-Big Brother... Could you pinch Rice's 
cheeks tight?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-Big Sister... Could you pinch Rice's 
cheeks?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: This has gotta be a dream, right...?
choice_data_list: This isn't a dream, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... I apologize. It seems I got a 
little too carried away myself...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I have compiled the details into 
documents, so please review and consider 
them later.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Well then, please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
......Incredible. Rice is making 
everyone...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

"And the next day—together with Rice 
Shower, we headed to Hanshin Racecourse."

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower! Next is your position for the 
bouquet presentation—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-Hyeees~!

text_block_list.name: Staff B
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, once that's finished, there's 
something I'd like to ask of you on our 
end as well—"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hawawa... Understood~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Whew...
choice_data_list: Shall we take a quick break?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe, I'll be fine. Because...

text_block_list.name: Staff C
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Rice Shower! Could we adjust 
your microphone one more time...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "Y-Yes! Coming right up!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to do my best until the very 
end. If it means putting a smile on 
everyone's faces."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So, everyone...! Please lend me your 
cheers!!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, that's a wrap!! That concludes 
today's rehearsal!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Phewww~ ...It's finally over... isn't 
it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... I'm okay. Even though there were 
lots of things I've never done before.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's actually happening, and everyone 
gathered here. ...When I realized there 
was something I could do...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"I don't feel tired at all. It just makes 
me want to try... even harder."

text_block_list.name: Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Rice-saaan! Looks like you left 
something in the back~

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hawa!? S-Sorry! I'll go get it right 
now...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eek!?
(CRACK... SNAP CRUNCH... THUD...!)

text_block_list.name: Staff C
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!? The gate is falling— 
Rice-san, look ou—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Brother!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Sister!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... *sob*... B-Big brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... *sob*... B-Big sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Big Brother! Big Brotherrr!! Are you 
okay?! Does it hurt anywhere—?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-Big Sister! Big Sister!! Are you okay!? 
Does it hurt anywhere—!?

...It looks like in shielding Rice Shower, 
I ended up hitting my head.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-Really!? B-But what about the hospital—

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank goodness!! You've opened your 
eyes! The ambulance will be here any 
minute!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I should be the one 
apologizing. I never expected it to break 
down so suddenly like that...

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"...I am terribly, terribly sorry. I will 
accompany you to the hospital."

And after getting examined at the 
hospital—

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? It is still under 
observation, but no abnormalities were 
found, you say—
choice_data_list: I'm so sorry for causing you worry.

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: No, we are the ones at fault.

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Besides... there is still something I must 
apologize to you all for.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-But everyone, you've already done 
enough...

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"—We've received notice that this 
ceremony, and the Takarazuka Kinen, will 
likely not be held at Hanshin."

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Actually... the cause of the paddock 
incident is still unknown.

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, people were injured. In that 
case, it would be necessary to inspect the 
entire racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"If so, it was determined that it would 
require at least three weeks, including 
inspection and repairs."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If we do that, we won't make it in time 
for the Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We've worked hard every day to 
prevent something like this... but this is 
an unprecedented situation...

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
...I am deeply sorry to both of you, as 
well as everyone who was looking forward 
to the Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Nothing happened until now, but the 
moment Rice arrived, all of a sudden...?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Could this be... Rice's fault?

That small voice, for some reason, echoed 
surprisingly loud and clear—
